notes: Routing fix: a named item now wins every time. 'Can you build me a general build for nyx' used to return the generic most-popular-builds list (Kuva Zarr one-shots) because 3-letter frame names were invisible mid-sentence and 'general' was not understood — Vaulty now resolves the named frame or weapon FIRST in every path (builds, qualified asks, the Workshop, the Build Checker, farm asks, follow-ups), and 'general' is a real qualifier that serves the item's balanced all-rounder: Nyx gets her Steel Path Balanced build, with the Psychic Bolts breakpoint computed from the build itself (full strip at 125% Strength; the build runs 168%). The popular list survives only for genuinely item-less browsing ('show me popular builds', 'what's strong right now'), which also rescues those phrasings from the don't-know punt.
